odia: ଥାଇକରି ଯେ ଖାଇମନ କରେ ତା ମୁହଁଟା ପୋଡ଼ୁ
title: A curse directed at craving
literal_meaning: Provisional reading: may the mouth of one who craves while having be burnt.
explanation: The headword defines wanting a particular food. The line curses someone described as having yet craving; it does not specify what is possessed or establish that their needs are met. Our critical reading separates a speaker’s accusation from knowledge of another’s circumstances. Neither the curse nor the accusation becomes advice about how a person should eat.
meaning_odia: ଖାଇମନ କରିବାର ଅର୍ଥ କୌଣସି ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଇଚ୍ଛା କରିବା। ଥାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚାହୁଁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କୁ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଅଭିଶାପ ଦିଏ। କଣ ଅଛି ବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ପୂରଣ ହୋଇଛି କି, ଉତ୍ସ କହେନାହିଁ; ଏହି ପାଠ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ କଥକଙ୍କ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟର ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଜାଣିବା ଅଲଗା। ଅଭିଶାପଟି ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବା ଆଚରଣର ପରାମର୍ଶ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: The accusation leaves the person’s possessions and actual needs unspecified.
odia_summary: କଣ ଅଛି ଓ କଣ ଦରକାର, ଅଭିଯୋଗଟି ତାହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ମାଗିବାରୁ ଜଣେ ଅତିଥିଙ୍କୁ ଦୋଷ ଦିଆଗଲା। ଘରଲୋକ ପ୍ରଥମେ ତାଙ୍କ କଥା ଶୁଣିବାକୁ କହିଲେ। / An imagined host asks others to hear a guest’s reason before judging a request. This alternative is invented.
cultural_context: The later pregnancy sense does not identify this subject. The following Nilamani Chintatarangini passage is a separate literary illustration, not this saying’s author.
